You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background- German and English business fluent- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisationsPreferred Qualifications- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscapeAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. Together with our commercial transfer network, we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application. Complex geospatial and resilience data models are deployed into active enterprise environments and infrastructure tools.
